name: Necromancer
description: A gaunt, powerful man in silks escorted by skeletal servants, seen driving the undead at the end.

timeline.summary: Brenalt, now crippled and leading a few dozen survivors, sees a necromancer directing the dead below.
timeline.quote: The necromancer was real, after all.

relations.note: He faces the necromancer's undead armies.
relations.quote: Down the valley below, he saw a gaunt man wrapped in silks, escorted by dozens of skeletal servants.

relations.note: Brenalt takes him for the driving force behind the dead.
relations.quote: The existence of a necromancer or demon as the driving force behind the enemy had been theorized

pages_say.description: A gaunt, powerful man in silks escorted by skeletal servants, seen driving the undead at the end.
